verdict.rationale: Vue's docs describe an "incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a library and a full-featured framework" (vue-docs-2). Official Router, Pinia and tooling cover the full-app end of that range (vue-docs-15). Community reports corroborate both ends: dropping Vue into existing templates for gradual adoption (vue-comm-4) and building full SPAs with the official router and store (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-15). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation showing how to mount Vue into part of an existing page and grow it into a full app (the evidence is a homepage tagline).
